CustomField.description: Whole days since the last Case Comment, falling back to when the Case was created so a brand-new Case with no comments still ages. Feeds the FSD 6.5 "no follow-up in 7 days" view. Because it contains NOW(), the nightly job must compute staleness in Apex from Last_Follow_Up_DateTime__c rather than filtering on this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days since follow-up was last logged. Counts from when the Case opened if nothing has been logged yet.
CustomField.label: Days Since Last Follow Up
